name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Middletown PA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck court is accessed from the internal east road at the NE corner of the property; the access is an open paved connection with no barrier arm or sliding gate visible in z20 satellite. Chain-link truck-court fencing is present along the dock face (seen in Street View) but the road entrance itself is uncontrolled. Classed false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any entrance in z20 satellite or Street View. Capital Logistics Center monument-sign entrance is wide and open.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Counted ~38 dock doors along the single north dock face from z19 imagery; regular bay rhythm with many trailers backed in. Approximate; comparable on-park Building 100 is documented at 39 doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: North truck court runs the full length of the building (~450 m), easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dropYard: North truck court doubles as trailer-storage; ~22 trailers parked away from active docks in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unfenced apron at the NE truck-court entrance and ample paved width to add a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Capital Logistics Center is an edge-of-town industrial park outside Middletown PA (Harrisburg metro fringe); per rubric small-town industrial resolves to Rural.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved truck court inside the dock court provides holding space before the dock doors.
